skill.name: qhsj-aigc-film
skill.language_policy: 中文为主，必要术语附英文
skill.routing_mode: semantic-first multi-label dependency-aware routing with explicit negative constraints, primary intent dispatch, full resource graph, asset-lock gates, and auditable review contracts

routing_contract.parallel_rules: Parallelize independent requirements review, reference classification, and read-only code checks. Serialize any dependency-sensitive writes: registry before graph, locked character/scene assets before storyboard assets, edits before regression tests, and any conflicting merge behind the orchestrator.
routing_contract.alias_policy: Keep every historical source path addressable. Exact byte-identical Markdown knowledge bodies are stored once; legacy paths become small compatibility stubs with original SHA-256 provenance, route to the canonical body, and inherit all canonical section routes.
routing_contract.uncertainty_policy: Route deterministic direct evidence, present unresolved ambiguity to the host model, and never claim exact natural-language semantic coverage without tests. Mark unavailable references or external tool executions as unverified.
routing_contract.priority: safety_and_policy > explicit_user_constraints > source_facts_and_canon > causality_spatial_action_physics > output_and_platform_contract > task_domain > aesthetics > optional_decoration
routing_contract.asset_lock_gate: Character and scene canonical assets must be specified, generated/received, validated, versioned and locked (or marked provisional) before generating any per-shot storyboard asset. Shot-level outputs must reference the locked asset IDs and versions.
routing_contract.agent_review_contract: Define independent review roles and findings contracts. A runtime must only claim genuine multi-agent execution if the host actually started separate agents; sequential role simulation must be labelled as such.
